Why pilots stall

Why do enterprise AI agent projects stall?

Four ways it tends to go wrong, and what we do instead.

  1. The demo looked great. The pilot never reached production.
  2. A platform was handed over, and the team was left to build on it.
  3. Nobody could say where the data runs or who approves what.
  4. Months of workshops, and still no working agent.
  1. Builds the agents on your own process, so you see them work before you commit.
  2. Puts our engineers beside your team to build the agents with you.
  3. Runs the agents in your cloud or on your prem, with a person signing off.
  4. Ships working agents in 72 hours, on sample or synthetic data.

Working agents on your exact process, in 72 hours.
